newsitem.title: FRANCE: Press Digest - France - Le Monde May 20.
newsitem.headline: Press Digest - France - Le Monde May 20.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- President Jacques Chirac warns voters against risks of co-habitation (power-sharing between a president and a government of opposing political parties) for European policy; says France must speak in a single voice.

-- Telecommunications operator France Telecom to launch mobile telephone offer targetted at private consumers and mass markets, rather than businesses; sees seven percent of the population using mobile telephone by end 1997 versus 4.3 percent at end 1996.
-- Air France to maintain over 50 percent of its medium-haul European and domestic flights in spite of a pilots' strike against project of lower wages for new pilots.
-- A 1993 state loan initiated by former Prime Minister Edouard Balladur, which comes to maturity on July 16, is said by the newspaper to have cost the state three to four billion francs.
